raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Management Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing operational risk management within the organization, referenced as a related document for comprehensive risk governance. This policy works in conjunction with incident response and security control frameworks to address operational threats and failures.

raw_entities.name: Incident Response Plan
raw_entities.description: A detailed procedural document outlining the bank's response protocols for security incidents and operational disruptions. This plan provides specific procedures for incident detection, escalation, investigation, and remediation.

raw_entities.name: Security Control Framework
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive framework documenting detailed security controls and safeguards implemented across the organization's systems and operations. This framework specifies the technical and procedural controls required to protect assets and data.

raw_entities.name: Technology Architecture and Security Measures Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy documenting the organization's technology architecture and the security measures embedded within systems infrastructure. This policy defines the technical foundation and security posture of the bank's systems.
